subject: NovaPayment virtual account & remittance routing — onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novapayment.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood-inference.com
Cc: accounts-payable@novapayment.com
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaPayment - bank details & virtual account setup

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the welcome call earlier. As requested, attached are our bank letter and a sample remittance CSV showing how we will send PO-level remittance for reconciliation. Quick highlights: 
- Bank: First Federal Bank (ACH / Wire)
- Beneficiary: NovaPayment, Inc.
- ACH routing: 121000358 | Account: 9876543210 (virtual account pool)
- Virtual account ID: VP-442-REDWOOD

Remittance sample (attached remit-sample.csv) includes columns: PAYMENT_ID, PAYMENT_DATE, AMOUNT, INVOICE_NUMBER, PO_NUMBER, REMIT_NOTES. We recommend mapping your PO label to the PO_NUMBER column.

We also attached a signed bank letter (NovaPayment_BankLetter.pdf) — notarized bank letter is on page 2. Please confirm if you need the original bank-letter by courier or if the PDF is sufficient for Redwood's vendor file.

Let us know when you schedule the micro-deposit and we'll provide the trace. Happy to hop on a short follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Finance Ops Lead
NovaPayment, Inc.
attachments: NovaPayment_BankLetter.pdf, remit-sample.csv
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novapayment.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood-inference.com, jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaPayment - bank details & virtual account setup

Thanks, Marta — received everything, and the PDF looks good. A few quick items before we move to payops: 

1) Remit CSV mapping: Can you confirm whether the external system ever populates PO_REFERENCE instead of PO_NUMBER? Our PO ingestion prefers an explicit PO_NUMBER column; if some feeds use PO_REFERENCE we’ll need a mapping table.

2) Micro-deposit: Please schedule a $0.10 test micro-deposit to the account above and reply with the expected trace id and expected ETA. We run automated micro-deposit checks against the trace.

3) Vendor onboarding form: I sent a DocuSign earlier today for the Redwood vendor onboarding (we need the W-9 and a primary AP contact). If you could sign and return that PDF, we can finish vendor creation in our ERP. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/sandbox/abc123-vendor-onboard

4) KYC/evidence: the notarized bank letter in the PDF is sufficient for our finops team, but if you have a bank letter on bank letterhead with an embedded bank stamp (rather than a notarization page), please add that — not required but speeds verification.

I'll loop in Priyom to confirm the PO mapping and Jonas for the PO label rules on our side. Once micro-deposit clears and onboarding form is signed we'll schedule the first remit.

Thanks,
Olga
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

Hi Olga — quick follow-up with the clarifications you requested.

1) PO mapping: Our payments engine always outputs PO_NUMBER when a PO exists. PO_REFERENCE is only used for certain manual payments; we will include PO_NUMBER in all automated remits to Redwood. Confirmed columns you should expect: PAYMENT_ID, PAYMENT_DATE, AMOUNT, INVOICE_NUMBER, PO_NUMBER, REMIT_NOTES.

2) Micro-deposit: The $0.10 micro-deposit was submitted this morning (Nov 2 15:00 EST). Trace ID: NP-TR-20281102-7783. Expected ACH posting window: 24–48 hours. I attached a short trace file (Microdeposit_Trace.txt) with the submission details.

3) DocuSign: I signed the vendor onboarding packet and returned it — attached as Vendor_Onboard_Signed.pdf. Please confirm receipt and that the W-9 is legible.

4) Additional evidence: We added a bank-stamped confirmation page to the bank letter; the page is included at the end of the PDF. If you still need a couriered original please advise.

Let me know when the micro-deposit reconciles on your side and we’ll coordinate the first scheduled remit.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Finance Ops Lead
NovaPayment, Inc.
attachments: Microdeposit_Trace.txt, Vendor_Onboard_Signed.pdf
